prompts.stone: Create a corrected seamless stone paving texture based on this style reference. Critical: the left and right boundaries must be the same continuous cross-section of paving, and top and bottom likewise. Design as a toroidal periodic surface: stone outlines crossing any boundary continue at the identical location and angle on its opposite boundary. Replace the layout if needed to accomplish this. No straight horizontal or vertical cutoff seams. Keep muted gray weathered irregular fitted stone paving with sparse olive moss, hand-painted top-down diffuse-lit opaque square, small readable slabs about 1/8 to 1/4 cell. Avoid lighting gradients, perimeter frames, perspective, extruded sides, grid, UI, text. Output one single texture, not repeated tiles or a preview.
prompts.water: Edit provided water terrain texture. Preserve its top-down hand-painted blue teal water and small ripples, opaque square diffuse-lit surface. Remove horizontal repeated bands and repair edges: all ripple shapes, colors and details must wrap continuously at left/right and top/bottom so 3x3 repeated copies have no visible rectangular joins. Reduce overly bright ripple contrast slightly for tactics tile readability. No shore, objects, perspective, directional light gradient, grid, UI, border or text. Output one square texture ideally 1024x1024, not a tiled preview.
prompts.grass_path: Edit the provided grass_path ground texture. Preserve hand-painted sage/olive meadow grass and tan worn earth, top-down opaque square uniform diffuse lighting and small feature scale. Repair vertical path joins: path centered perfectly on x=50%, with identical width and shape at top and bottom (roughly 30% of cell), gradual gentle irregular edges only in the interior. Match top/bottom earth grain, grass and stones continuously. Left/right grass edges must also wrap without joins. No repeated horizontal bands, tile borders, cast shadows, perspective, blocks, UI, grid or text. Single square texture ideally 1024x1024, not a contact sheet. Keep recognizable path material and natural style.
